description: Four closed sessions trigger cumulative rollup (threshold 3); session 5 recall tests M2 memory of rolled-up and recent facts

turns.content: I want to lose 5 kg in three months. I cannot eat shellfish.

Try lactose-free milk or soy milk and monitor bloating symptoms.
I walk 30 minutes every evening after dinner.

I will focus on chicken and fish instead of red meat for dinners.
